title: Product
description: Read-only retained product evidence from Postgres. Tables are current snapshots, independent of the Grafana time picker; each title states its window. No provider calls or content jobs. Use app Status for configured caps, reserve amounts and live budget availability.

panels.title: Provider spend and outstanding holds (UTC)
panels.description: Settled spend is attributed to call creation in UTC. Holds include all pending/uncertain calls, including earlier days. Caps and live available funds are in app Status; holds are not additional settled spend. Pending and uncertain counts include all days; oldest hold age uses call creation time, not a retry heartbeat. Empty provider ledgers show zero totals with no hold age.

targets.rawSql: WITH providers(provider) AS (VALUES ('Anthropic'),('X discovery')), calls AS (SELECT 'Anthropic' AS provider, created_at, status, cost_micros, reserved_micros FROM llm_calls UNION ALL SELECT 'X discovery', created_at, status, cost_micros, reserved_micros FROM x_discovery_calls) SELECT providers.provider AS "Provider", coalesce(sum(cost_micros) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'),0)/1000000.0 AS "Today ($)", coalesce(sum(cost_micros) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'),0)/1000000.0 AS "Month ($)", coalesce(sum(reserved_micros) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('pending','uncertain')),0)/1000000.0 AS "Holds ($)", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='pending')::int AS "Pending", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='uncertain')::int AS "Uncertain", extract(epoch FROM (now()-min(created_at) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('pending','uncertain'))))/3600 AS "Oldest hold (h)" FROM providers LEFT JOIN calls USING (provider) GROUP BY providers.provider ORDER BY "Provider"

panels.title: Latest edition editorial modes
panels.description: Latest retained immutable edition, including manual editions. AI mode may reuse cached work; it does not prove a fresh paid call. Worker timing is in Jobs and app Status.

targets.rawSql: SELECT d.created_at AS "Created (UTC)", t->>'name' AS "Topic", t->'editorial'->>'mode' AS "Stories", t->'postEditorial'->>'mode' AS "Posts" FROM (SELECT created_at, snapshot FROM digest_previews ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) d CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(d.snapshot->'topics') t

panels.title: Source freshness and current errors
panels.description: Current source snapshots; no error messages or source URLs are returned. A successful empty response may contain no new items.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name AS "Source", last_success AS "Last success (UTC)", last_item_count AS "Items", CASE WHEN last_error IS NULL THEN 'no current error' ELSE 'error (see Status)' END AS "State" FROM content_sources ORDER BY last_success ASC NULLS FIRST, name LIMIT 100

panels.title: Distinct articles per topic (rolling 24 hours)
panels.description: Publication timestamps, deduplicated within each topic. Includes disabled topics and sources; this is retained ingestion coverage, not edition picks.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.name AS topic, count(DISTINCT i.id)::int AS articles FROM topics t LEFT JOIN content_sources s ON s.topic_id=t.id LEFT JOIN content_observations o ON o.source_id=s.id LEFT JOIN content_items i ON i.id=o.item_id AND i.published_at >= now()-interval '24 hours' AND i.published_at <= now() GROUP BY t.id,t.name ORDER BY t.name

panels.title: X citation verification (rolling 24 hours)
panels.description: Distinct cited IDs per topic from direct X discovery. Verification means a retained official embed exists now; not incremental yield or engagement. Empty means no citations in this window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(t.name,'deleted/unknown') AS topic, count(DISTINCT c.external_id)::int AS cited_posts, count(DISTINCT c.external_id) FILTER (WHERE p.external_id IS NOT NULL)::int AS verified_posts FROM x_search_citations c LEFT JOIN topics t ON t.id=c.topic_id LEFT JOIN social_posts p ON p.platform='x' AND p.external_id=c.external_id WHERE c.discovered_at >= now()-interval '24 hours' GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY topic

panels.title: Scheduled reserve lifecycle (latest seven days)
panels.description: Durable lifecycle only. Protected reserve amount, cap and current availability are read from configuration by app Status, not inferred here. Pending is not a missed run before its scheduled time. Updated is the last durable lifecycle write, not a heartbeat. Open overdue minutes is shown only for pending/running/retrying states after the scheduled time; it does not establish failure or worker duration. Snapshot ignores the time picker.

targets.rawSql: SELECT budget_day::text AS "Day (UTC)", scheduled_at AS "Scheduled (UTC)", state AS "State", attempt AS "Attempt", updated_at AS "Updated (UTC)", CASE WHEN state IN ('pending','running','retrying') THEN greatest(0, extract(epoch FROM (now()-scheduled_at))/60)::numeric(12,1) END AS "Open overdue (min)" FROM scheduled_ai_budget_days ORDER BY budget_day DESC LIMIT 7

panels.title: Source article coverage (24 hours and 7 days)
panels.description: Distinct retained articles by publication time, attributed to each source, including zero counts. Seven-day counts include the last 24 hours. Multiple sources may cite the same article; do not sum these as unique topic coverage. Includes disabled sources/topics. Last response count includes older and duplicate items and is not new-item yield. Fixed rolling windows ignore the time picker.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(t.name,'Shared / all topics') AS "Topic", s.name AS "Source", count(DISTINCT i.id) FILTER (WHERE i.published_at >= now()-interval '24 hours')::int AS "Articles (24h)", count(DISTINCT i.id)::int AS "Articles (7d)", s.last_item_count AS "Last response items", s.last_success AS "Last success (UTC)", (s.last_error IS NOT NULL) AS "Current error" FROM content_sources s LEFT JOIN topics t ON t.id=s.topic_id LEFT JOIN content_observations o ON o.source_id=s.id LEFT JOIN content_items i ON i.id=o.item_id AND i.published_at >= now()-interval '7 days' AND i.published_at <= now() GROUP BY t.id,t.name,s.id,s.name,s.last_item_count,s.last_success,s.last_error ORDER BY "Topic","Articles (24h)","Articles (7d)","Source"

panels.title: Recent retained editions (latest seven)
panels.description: Immutable edition snapshots, including manual editions and older revisions. Created time is publication storage time, not worker duration. AI topic counts describe recorded editorial modes, which may reuse cache; no live latency or fresh-provider claim.

targets.rawSql: SELECT d.created_at AS "Created (UTC)", totals.* FROM (SELECT created_at,snapshot FROM digest_previews ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 7) d CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*)::int AS "Topics", sum(jsonb_array_length(coalesce(t->'stories','[]'::jsonb)))::int AS "Stories", sum(jsonb_array_length(coalesce(t->'posts','[]'::jsonb)))::int AS "Posts", count(*) FILTER (WHERE t->'editorial'->>'mode'='ai')::int AS "AI story topics", count(*) FILTER (WHERE t->'postEditorial'->>'mode'='ai')::int AS "AI post topics" FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.snapshot->'topics') t) totals ORDER BY d.created_at DESC

panels.title: AI ledger by edition (latest seven)
panels.description: Anthropic ledger matched by edition UUID, never timestamp overlap. Settled charges include failed calls with recorded cost; holds are pending/uncertain reservations. Zero calls may mean cached or fallback work. Excludes X discovery and unpublished attempts/retries; not total scheduled-run spend. Created time is not worker duration.

targets.rawSql: SELECT d.created_at AS "Created (UTC)", left(d.id::text,8) AS "Edition", count(c.run_id)::int AS "Calls", count(c.run_id) FILTER (WHERE c.status IN ('pending','uncertain'))::int AS "Unresolved", coalesce(sum(c.cost_micros),0)/1000000.0 AS "Charged ($)", coalesce(sum(c.reserved_micros) FILTER (WHERE c.status IN ('pending','uncertain')),0)/1000000.0 AS "Holds ($)" FROM (SELECT id,created_at FROM digest_previews ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 7) d LEFT JOIN llm_calls c ON c.run_id=d.id::text GROUP BY d.id,d.created_at ORDER BY d.created_at DESC,d.id DESC

panels.title: Edition worker mean duration (since worker start)
panels.description: Mean settled processor attempt time since the current worker started, split by job name and outcome. Includes cached, fallback and reused editions; not a cold AI latency measurement. Excludes queue wait; retries count separately. No data until an attempt is observed; killed attempts are absent.

panels.title: Edition worker attempts (since worker start)
panels.description: Settled attempts since the current worker started, split by job name and outcome. Retries count separately, and completion can reuse an existing edition. Not the number of published editions. No samples means no observed attempts, not zero failures. Counters reset on worker restart.

panels.title: Latest edition selection coverage
panels.description: Latest retained immutable edition, including manual editions. Scored counts are stored triage rows and can come from cache; unscored counts are recorded IDs, not all rejected candidates. Missing editorial metadata stays blank. Reasons describe the stored selection outcome, not live provider health.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t->>'name' AS "Topic", section.kind AS "Section", section.selected AS "Selected", jsonb_array_length(section.editorial->'triage') AS "Scored", jsonb_array_length(section.editorial->'unscoredIds') AS "Unscored", section.editorial->>'mode' AS "Mode", section.editorial->>'reason' AS "Reason" FROM (SELECT snapshot FROM digest_previews ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1) d CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(d.snapshot->'topics') WITH ORDINALITY AS topics(t, position) CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('Stories', jsonb_array_length(t->'stories'), t->'editorial'), ('Posts', jsonb_array_length(t->'posts'), t->'postEditorial')) AS section(kind,selected,editorial) ORDER BY topics.position, section.kind DESC
